title: pseudopanax macintyrei

This plant is traditionally used in New Zealand for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to support digestive health and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Pseudopanax macintyrei include lignans, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, although further research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds and health benefits.
